text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"In this corner is the ideal of<n>Japanese beauty and
might! The<n>unwavering wrestler, Graaaass
Wonderrr!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! Spe, did you eat something<n>funny?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... "And in this corner, she'll<n>show you that
Hokkaido spirit! It's<n>the wrestler with guts of steel,
Speciaaaal Weeek!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And finally, she's here! The one to<n>fear! The
world's strongest! The<n>raging tempest, the
lightspeed storm<n>of a masked wrestler!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Time to celebrate, El! We've got a<n>party all set up
for you in the<n>cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sei and King are already waiting for<n>us there.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's go, let's go! Let's go right<n>nooow!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Today, just for today, I think I can<n>let a couple
tears slide while the<n>mask is on.
